HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the House and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Education 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Sewing Tools,  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
